findings.finding: «صرف پڑھنے والی تشخیص» departs from the established predicate form «صرف پڑھنے کے لیے». In this attributive slot the established form would read «diagnosis for reading only»; «صرف پڑھنے والی» ('that only reads') carries the read-only meaning of a command that changes nothing better. «(شیئر کرنا محفوظ ہے)» keeps safe-to-share.
